o.text: From Proto-Turkic *yaŋï, *yeŋi (“new”). Cognate with Old Turkic 𐰖‬𐰭‬𐰃 (yaŋï).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *sač (“hair”). Compare Turkish saç (“hair”).
Morphologically dəy- + -ənək. Cognate with Turkish değnek.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آداقلو (adaqlu). By surface analysis, adax + -lı.
